segments.name: Retail and Commercial Banking
segments.description: A bank segment serving retail and commercial customers with loans, deposits, government-guaranteed lending and mortgage warehouse funding.
segments.evidence: The segment's revenues are primarily derived from retail and commercial banking products, and investment income.

revenueModel.text: The bank earns interest and fees from loans to retail and commercial customers, government-guaranteed lending and short term funding to non-bank mortgage loan originators.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company has a nationwide residential mortgage warehouse division, MBF, which provides short term funding to non-bank mortgage loan originators.
